message: stage files explicitly with 'git add <file>' — unstaged changes may not be yours
never force push. if diverged: 'git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main && git push'
use 'trash <file>' instead of rm — recoverable deletion

do not launch the amp CLI from bash — this session's persona is Amp but that binary is a separate program. use the delegate / oracle / finder / code_review / librarian tools, which run inside this pi session with your tools, permissions and visible output

use the screenshot tool instead of capturing by hand — it takes the same shot and fits the image to the vision budget in ONE resample pass, where the hand-rolled way resizes to a guessed long edge that ignores the visual-token limit and makes the API resample a second time. displays, windows, regions and whole web pages are all supported; call screenshot({ list: true }) to see the targets
